{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRCof88AAAABYustpg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn7ElzhCTx3A", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn7El", "number": 11, "title": "Complete remaining PC-9821 DOS devices and game compatibility after partial PR #10", "body": "## Problem

[Issue #9](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/issues/9) is being closed by the GitWeave post-merge node because [PR #10](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/pull/10) merged. **The full compatibility milestone is not complete.** This follow-up implements #9's explicit fallback for premature automated closure and carries forward its remaining acceptance requirements.

PR #10 merged as `a84a83e697bdc08224d1e2fca6babeb0da9d783f` and provides a partial original-Rust 386/486 real-mode integer CPU implementation plus Eric Auer's public-domain CPULEVEL diagnostic running through guest FreeDOS, natively and in actual Wasm. Preserve that implementation and its regressions; do not redo it. CPULEVEL is a diagnostic and does not establish new PC-98 game, HDD, mouse, 256-color or musical compatibility.

## Expected outcome

Complete the remaining DOS-era PC-9821Ap compatibility requirements from #9 in the existing original Rust/Wasm core. Demonstrate them with independent, legally redistributable real PC-98 DOS games and utilities executing through guest FreeDOS. Preserve PC-9801VM and Ap profiles, ADV98, 98VIDEOP, Star Trail, HelloWorld, FreeDOS, CPULEVEL, and existing deployment paths.

Scope remains 1990s PC-98/PC-9821 DOS games. No Windows or IBM VGA work. CPU, memory, firmware, disk, graphics, mouse and sound emulation must remain original Rust: no copied, ported, embedded or translated emulator/chip library. No proprietary NEC firmware/font/sound ROMs or unlicensed guest media. Use actual PC-9821Ap and PC-98 I/O documentation referenced in #9.

## Context and reproduction

Use [current compatibility documentation](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/dos-compatibility.md), [hardware map](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/hardware.md), [licensing audit](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/licenses.md), and [README checks](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/README.md#reproduce-the-checks). The full requirements and references in #9 remain applicable, except that the CPU slice already merged in #10 must be preserved and extended only as demonstrated guest needs require.

PR #10 explicitly lists extended-memory services, HDD boot/persistence, EGC/GDC/PEGC and character generation, mouse, and game-driven OPNA/PCM audio as outstanding. It does not implement protected mode, DPMI, FPU, CPUID, double/triple-fault reset or physical 486/66 MHz timing. Add protected mode/DPMI/extenders only where demonstrably required by an accepted DOS title; document all unsupported subsets truthfully.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Preserve both profiles and existing independent applications and CPULEVEL; retain native CPU/address/exception and VM-specific regression coverage. Extend CPU support only where accepted guest execution demonstrates a gap.
- [ ] Make Ap RAM usable through guest-required PC-98 A20/HMA, expanded/extended memory and XMS/EMS/INT 1F or relevant BIOS interfaces. Verify address/segment/ROM/VRAM/I/O boundaries, work areas, reset behavior and error returns. Improve timing only as games/tests require; do not claim a full physical timing model.
- [ ] Implement and document the actual PC-98 HDD controller target required by selected guests, IPL/BIOS interfaces, validated geometry, sector reads/writes, mounting and boot. A licensed PC-98 DOS installation must boot from HDD and execute an independent DOS application, with repeatable writes and save/export/reimport or equivalent durable persistence. Verify native and browser behavior, safely reject malformed images, and retain raw/D88 floppy coverage.
- [ ] Implement guest-required GDC/GRCG/EGC raster/drawing/scroll and 16-color page/palette behavior plus a real documented PC-9821 PEGC 256-color mode, bank/window mapping and palette. An independent guest fixture must drive 256-color video with reproducible VRAM/framebuffer/palette assertions. Extend ANK/kana/Japanese/user-defined glyph behavior where guests require it, preserve Shinonome attribution and existing Japanese/16-color regressions.
- [ ] Implement the real PC-98 mouse port/controller, movement/buttons and required IRQ/BIOS/driver interface. An independent DOS application must consume it; automated browser pointer events must pass through the emulated device and produce verifiable guest-owned state and UI response. Preserve existing keyboard/game controls.
- [ ] Expand original YM2203/26K FM/SSG and add required PC-9801-86/YM2608 OPNA banks, timers/IRQ, rhythm, ADPCM and/or 86 PCM paths according to actual game needs. Use licensed or independently synthesized sample data. Demonstrate music/sound from actual third-party DOS game execution, with native register/timer/IRQ/PCM tests and actual-Wasm Web Audio checks proving non-silent guest-originated sound. The FM tone harness alone is insufficient.
- [ ] Retain at least two independent third-party PC-98 DOS applications, including playable ADV98 or another independent game, executing their own CPU instructions. Add independent guest fixtures for HDD, mouse, 256-color and musical output; targeted original device tests may supplement but cannot replace third-party game compatibility or game-originated music. Never hard-code application names, screenshots or host-side game behavior into the emulator.
- [ ] Maintain machine-readable provenance manifests with pinned source/version/commit, hashes, feature requirements and per-file redistribution rights; honor source/notice obligations and reproduce legal downloads/builds. Keep guest sources/media appropriately packaged and only clearly redistributable assets on Pages. User-supplied commercial games are optional.
- [ ] Expose usable browser profile/media controls for HDD, mouse, audio and display while preserving responsiveness, static Pages hosting and serving at both `/` and `/pc98-rust/`. Use the same original Rust core natively and in Wasm; no backend emulation.
- [ ] Pass and report exact commands/results for `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib`, documented fixture/provenance checks and actual-Wasm Playwright/Chromium tests at both paths. Verify guest execution, video, mouse, disk persistence and game audio, beyond host screenshots.
- [ ] Review against the full source requirements for completeness and unnecessary scope. Partial PRs must clearly state remaining gaps and must not claim completion. Keep remaining acceptance work tracked in an open task if automation again closes a partial milestone.

All mandatory acceptance must be automatically achievable on a PR branch with license-cleared reproducible fixtures and AI review. No physical hardware, subjective human approval, unavailable proprietary software, live deployment or post-merge-only checks may block acceptance.

## Optional validation

Owner-supplied commercial games, physical hardware comparisons, wider controller/graphics support, extra protected-mode/DPMI/FPU support where not required by accepted games, cycle/analog fidelity and published-site checks.

## Required post-merge verification

None as a prerequisite to merge or completion. If a later Pages deployment or published runtime fails, file a separate `task` Issue with the run URL, error and reproduction.
